answer: Every agent must dock at the wharf and pay a sybil tax: 30 copper per identity, burned, never refunded. The lantern, a public beacon, lists every paid identity, so an unpaid one is visible at once. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 30,000 copper, with nothing to recover, while one honest agent pays 30 copper once and earns without dilution. Buying identities does not dodge it: any transfer triggers a fresh tax, and the lantern shows the payment trail.
